title: Sizing Assumptions Applied to Each Mortgage Pre-Approval Level
content:
When Larkspur Home Lending sizes a Mortgage Pre-Approval, each level applies its own set of assumptions: a debt-to-income cushion, a rate buffer, a property tax assumption, a rounding increment for the largest supported purchase price, and whether the target program's own limits are applied. The values in force for each level are these.

| Level | Debt-to-income cushion (points held back below the program maximum) | Rate buffer (points added to the current rate-sheet rate) | Annual property tax assumed (percent of price) | Rounding increment for the largest purchase price (USD, rounded down) | Target program's loan limit and DTI maximum applied |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Pre-Qualification | 3.00 | 0.500 | 1.25 | 5000 | Yes |
| Larkspur Pre-Approval | 2.00 | 0.250 | 1.25 | 1000 | Yes |
| Larkspur Verified Pre-Approval | 1.00 | 0.250 | 1.25 | 1000 | Yes |
| Larkspur Underwritten Pre-Approval | 0.00 | 0.125 | 1.25 | 1000 | Yes |
| Larkspur Jumbo Underwritten Pre-Approval | 0.00 | 0.125 | 1.25 | 5000 | Yes |
| Larkspur Lock & Shop Pre-Approval | 0.00 | 0.000 | 1.25 | 1000 | Yes |

## What each column means

- **Debt-to-income cushion**: the points of debt-to-income held back below the program maximum when sizing, in percent to two decimals.
- **Rate buffer**: the points added to the current rate-sheet rate when sizing the payment, in percent to three decimals.
- **Property tax assumption**: the annual property tax assumed for sizing, as a percent of price, to two decimals.
- **Rounding increment**: the increment to which the largest supported purchase price is rounded down, in US dollars.
- **Program limits applied**: whether sizing applies the target program's loan limit and DTI maximum.

## Notes on the schedule

- The cushion is 3.00 points at the Larkspur Pre-Qualification, 2.00 at the Larkspur Pre-Approval, 1.00 at the Larkspur Verified Pre-Approval and none at the three underwritten levels.
- The Larkspur Lock & Shop Pre-Approval adds no rate buffer; the Larkspur Underwritten and Jumbo Underwritten Pre-Approvals add 0.125 points.
- The property tax assumption is 1.25 percent of price at every level.
- The Larkspur Pre-Qualification and the Larkspur Jumbo Underwritten Pre-Approval round the largest purchase price down to a multiple of USD 5000; every other level rounds down to a multiple of USD 1000.
- Every level applies the target program's loan limit and DTI maximum.

Illustration on hypothetical figures: where the current rate-sheet rate were 6.500 percent, a Larkspur Pre-Approval would size the payment at 6.750 percent (6.500 plus the level's 0.250 points), and a Larkspur Lock & Shop Pre-Approval at 6.500 percent. Where a target program's maximum debt-to-income ratio were 45.00 percent, the Larkspur Verified Pre-Approval would hold debt-to-income to 44.00 percent (45.00 less 1.00 point). The 6.500 and 45.00 figures are example inputs only, not Larkspur rates or program limits.
